description.value: Pasargad has been serving traditional Persian cuisine in Coquitlam since 2010, specializing in saffron-marinated kebabs, slow-cooked stews, and authentic rice dishes. The restaurant aims to make Persian cooking more accessible in the Tri-Cities area, drawing on centuries-old recipes while using fresh local ingredients. A touring cyclist can sit down for a full dine-in meal or order takeout with free delivery across Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, and Port Moody.
